code:
Gain or Loss =
  Proceeds of Sale
  - Cost of Removal
  - Net Book Value

Positive = gain
Negative = loss
caption: Every retirement, full or partial, runs through this same formula.

code:
Cost:                      $45,000
Accumulated depreciation:  $38,000
Net book value:              $7,000

Proceeds of sale:            $9,500
Cost of removal:               $300

Gain/Loss = $9,500 - $300 - $7,000
          = $2,200 (gain)
caption: A gain means proceeds, net of removal cost, exceeded the remaining book value.
